name: Noble Mounted-Host Exemptions
description: Great houses retain wider fiscal and local immunities in exchange for specified cataphracts, horse archers, remounts, equipment, and campaign seasons.
note: Great-house mounted service is secure, while exact exemptions and quotas remain bounded gameplay values.

name: Standing Royal Garrisons
description: The royal court maintains more directly supplied frontier and urban garrisons, improving command continuity while reducing reliance on great-house hosts.
note: Direct royal forces and garrisons are plausible and situational; the privilege does not project a later centralized standing army onto the whole Arsacid period.
